notes: Every rule is evaluated against a measured metrics sample (prod_metrics.py).
No external alerting integration exists in this environment; the evaluator writes
run/alerts/alerts.json (state) and run/alerts/alerts.log (transitions), which is where
a pager integration would be attached. Nothing here is simulated.
'verification' names the command that was actually used to prove the rule fires.

rules.description: the API process is not RUNNING under supervisord
rules.response: prod.sh status; prod.sh logs backend 200; restart with prod.sh restart backend; if it fails again check the data root and secrets, then roll back with prod.sh rollback
rules.verification: prod_faults.py --case api-crash (process killed, alerts fire, autorestarts, alert clears)

rules.description: the frontend process is not RUNNING under supervisord
rules.response: prod.sh status; prod.sh logs frontend 200; prod.sh restart frontend

rules.description: the host watchdog that keeps supervisord alive is not running
rules.response: prod.sh watchdog start; confirm with prod.sh status; without the watchdog nothing restarts supervisord itself
rules.verification: prod_faults.py --case supervisor-kill (supervisord killed, watchdog restarted it)

rules.description: the API readiness probe is not answering 200
rules.response: prod.sh health; check database/storage health in the same sample; prod.sh logs backend
rules.verification: prod_faults.py --case api-stop (API stopped; readiness reports unhealthy, alert fires, recovery clears it)

rules.response: prod.sh logs frontend 200; prod.sh restart frontend

rules.description: the validation ingress does not reach the frontend over TLS
rules.response: prod.sh status (ingress is a validation component); verify the platform edge separately for the public origin

rules.description: at least one SQLite store failed PRAGMA integrity_check
rules.response: prod.sh fingerprint; identify the store; restore it from the newest verified backup with prod.sh restore into a rehearsal root, validate, then promote the restore
rules.verification: prod_verify.py (integrity of all stores) plus prod_restore.py rehearsal

rules.description: the newest backup is older than 26 hours
rules.response: prod.sh backup --label manual; check the scheduler (prod.sh logs watchdog) and disk space
run prod.sh backup and investigate why the scheduler did not; do not promote any release until a verified backup exists

rules.description: the newest backup did not verify (integrity or hash failure)
rules.response: inspect evidence/backup-*.json and run prod.sh backup again; treat unverified backups as absent
rules.verification: prod_backup.py returns non-zero on verification failure; prod_faults.py --case backup-failure

rules.response: prod.sh backups (prune old backups); inspect data growth; plan capacity (documented limits in the closure report)
rules.verification: prod_verify.py --section resources (recorded usage) and prod_faults.py --case disk-pressure

rules.description: filesystem nearly full: writes will start failing
rules.response: prune backups, clear runtime caches, and expand the volume; the API answers sanitised 500s for failed writes
rules.verification: prod_faults.py --case disk-pressure (write failure path exercised on a bounded filesystem)

rules.description: recent ERROR/Traceback lines in the backend log
rules.response: prod.sh logs backend 400; correlate with the access lines the app writes for non-200 responses
rules.verification: prod_faults.py --case storage-readonly (sanitised 500 recorded in the log, response carries no stack trace)

rules.description: the auth secret is not mode 0600
rules.response: chmod 600 the file; the release start script refuses to start with a world-readable secret, so this alert precedes a hard failure
rules.verification: prod_faults.py --case secret-missing (start refusal and alert) and prod_verify.py --section secrets

rules.description: the API process restarted more than three times in the last hour
rules.response: prod.sh logs backend 400 for the crash loop cause; consider rollback with prod.sh rollback
rules.verification: derived from the metrics series collected by prod_metrics.py --loop during the failure runs

rules.description: the validation ingress certificate expires within 21 days
rules.response: re-issue it with prod_bootstrap.sh (idempotent) or a documented openssl command in the runbook
rules.verification: prod_verify.py --section tls (certificate days measured) and prod_faults.py --case cert-expired

rules.description: EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY: the production certificate is issued by the platform edge for the public origin and cannot be inspected from inside the deployment host
rules.response: monitor the platform edge certificate from an external client (Arena preview / external HTTPS check); renew on the platform side
rules.verification: not verifiable from inside the sandbox: classified as an external dependency in the closure report, with the external check named

rules.description: the `current` release symlink is missing: the deployment has no promoted release
